rca of the issue: RCA-1 CORS: Repro via OPTIONS /api/auth/login with Origin=https://delivery-dispatch-17.preview.emergentagent.com and Access-Control-Request-Method=POST returns ACAO='*'. Expected explicit origin due credentialed cookies. Likely ingress/edge preflight response path bypasses/overrides backend explicit-origin middleware. 'B' : 'S'`), which directly violates full-name source requirement.
